t: The Curated Gallery: Distilling Excel Tab Generation for SEO
s: This technical article details the modularization of a complex Jupyter Notebook cell into a reusable Python function for generating multi-tab Excel reports. It emphasizes refactoring procedural code into clean, automated deliverables for SEO analytics, catering to both detailed notebook users and future web application users.
